<!-- cli-reference:start — generated by `go run ./tools/sitecli` from the CLI; edit the command's help in the code, not this block -->

Compile the documentation from the templates in `doct/`.

```text
The documentation has three layers, and the content lives in ONE:

  *.spec.md        the source — the content lives here, and only here
  doct/*.md.tmpl   the template — the frame, which REFERENCES excerpts of the specs
  docs/*.md        the compiled — real content, generated, nobody edits it

Markdown has no native inclusion: without a build, the only way out would be to duplicate by hand, and
duplication written by hand goes stale without anyone seeing. Here the duplication exists only in the
compiled, where the `docs-fresh` flags it when it ages.
```

## Usage

```bash
anchors docs
```

## Subcommands

### `anchors docs build`

Compile `doct/*.md.tmpl` into `docs/*.md`.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors docs build [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--dry-run` |  | compile without writing (this is what the gate uses) |
| `--map` |  | map path (default: <root>/anchors.graph.yaml) |
| `--max-lines` | `2000` | above N spec lines in total, likewise — five long specs weigh more than twenty short ones |
| `--max-units` | `20` | above N units, the layer page carries the SUMMARY of each one |
| `--no-map-rebuild` |  | compile against the map on disk, without rebuilding it — what it does not know does not get in |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

### `anchors docs duties`

List the project's mandatory documents and what each requires.

#### Usage

```bash
anchors docs duties [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--layer` |  | only those required when changing this layer |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |
| `--unit` |  | only those required when changing THIS unit (more precise than --layer) |

### `anchors docs init`

Write the skeleton of `doct/` (arquitetura, comportamento, regras, camadas).

#### Usage

```bash
anchors docs init [flags]
```

#### Flags

| Flag | Default | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `--force` |  | overwrite existing templates |
| `--root` | `.` | project root |

## Setup and artifacts — family

Commands of the same family — what tells each apart:

| Command | What it does |
| --- | --- |
| [`anchors init`](/docs/cli/commands/init/) | Configure the project (anchors.yaml) through questions and answers |
| [`anchors new`](/docs/cli/commands/new/) | Emit the skeleton of an artifact (spec, feature, test, plan…) per the ruler |
| [`anchors code`](/docs/cli/commands/code/) | Generate a unique identity code for a new unit |
| [`anchors guide`](/docs/cli/commands/guide/) | Print the Anchors guides for AI agents |
| **`anchors docs`** | Compile the documentation from the templates in `doct/` |
| [`anchors install-hooks`](/docs/cli/commands/install-hooks/) | Install the git pre-commit that runs the gates over staged files |
| [`anchors migrate`](/docs/cli/commands/migrate/) | Bring the Anchors files up to the current format |
| [`anchors settings`](/docs/cli/commands/settings/) | This agent's LOCAL configuration — what is its own, not the project's |
| [`anchors touch`](/docs/cli/commands/touch/) | Bump `updated_at` in the @anchors header of the files that changed |
